title: Key follow-ups: status nudge for [ and ], Waves show-all on A, help wording and hidden tab help

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S105 relay (2026-10-26). Owner decisions 2026-10-26 (session a2bf7e0e): (a) when left/right do nothing on Overview, Roadmap, Waves or Questions, the status line says '[ and ] switch projects' (no layout cost); (b) Waves moves show-all from a to A, matching Decisions (today model.go and waves.go bind a). Other notes: (1) the TabNext/TabPrev help strings in internal/tui/keys.go are never shown (not in FullHelp); (2) help says 'next/previous project' although [ and ] also land on Running and Needs you; (3) the full help golden ends '+2 more lines' (pre-existing); (4) adj records 112 and 120 still name left/right as project keys in their option text (the owner amends or supersedes; agents do not).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestStatusNudgeWhenLeftRightDoNothing (Overview, Roadmap, Waves, Questions: status says '[ and ] switch projects'); TestWavesShowAllIsCapitalA (a no longer toggles; A does, matching Decisions); TestHelpShowsTabNextTabPrev or the help strings are removed; TestHelpSaysProjectsAndEntries ([ and ] also land on Running and Needs you); TestFullHelpGoldenFits (no '+2 more lines'); goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor from the code after S151 (sidebar and help changed). Owner decisions 2026-10-26: left/right doing nothing sets the status '[ and ] switch projects' (no layout cost); Waves show-all moves from a to A. Fix the other notes: unused TabNext/TabPrev help strings (show or delete), help wording 'next/previous project' to say entries, the full help golden cut. adj 112 and 120 option text is the owner's to amend (agents do not). UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui (and the packages named in Files); goldens (go test ./internal/tui -update, review the diff); go vet ./...; gofmt -l .; slicer check; adj lint.
